title: Relationship Pricing Note — Operating Credit Allowance Against Late Charges on Farm Real Estate Loans
content:
The member's operating credit earns a further credit taken off the late-charge percentage on a Farm Real Estate Loans installment: a member holding an operating line in active status that is collected by AutoDraft receives 0.25 percentage point; a member holding an operating line in active status that is not on AutoDraft receives 0.10 percentage point; any other member receives none. The late-charge percentage left after credits is never below zero.

**What the records show.** The member's Operating Lines of Credit records: each line's status and whether it is enrolled in AutoDraft.

| Member's Operating Lines of Credit | Credit (percentage points) |
|---|---|
| A line in active status collected by AutoDraft | 0.25 |
| A line in active status not on AutoDraft | 0.10 |
| No line in active status | none |

**Illustrations (hypothetical).** A member with a Seasonal Operating Loan in active status paid by AutoDraft: 0.25. A member whose only operating line has matured: none. A member whose Revolving Operating Line is active but paid by check: 0.10.
